slots.jd.subscription-box.about:
About the role
Fairlane Subscription Box is a small team that ships surprise boxes to subscribers every month, and our customers are the reason we exist. We're looking for a Customer Support Representative who likes solving problems, writes clearly and stays calm when a box goes missing. You'll be the friendly voice people reach when something isn't right, and you'll help us get better every time.
slots.jd.subscription-box.duties:
What you'll do
- Answer subscriber questions by chat, email and phone, and keep every reply friendly and clear
- Resolve complaints about late, damaged or missing boxes and follow each one through to a fix
- Document tickets carefully so anyone on the team can pick up a case without starting over
- Track customer satisfaction scores and flag trends the team should know about
- Pass recurring product and shipping issues to the right people with the details they need
- Suggest updates to our help content when the same questions keep coming in
slots.jd.subscription-box.needs:
What we're looking for
- 2 or more years of experience in customer support
- Escalation handling skills and a calm approach with frustrated customers
- Knowledge base writing that turns common questions into clear help articles
- Comfort with macros and templates, plus good judgment about when to write a reply from scratch
- Experience with satisfaction surveys and acting on what customers tell you
- Familiarity with refund processing and account verification
slots.r1.b1: Escalates reproducible bugs to engineering with clear notes gathered through phone support, cutting repeat contacts on known issues by 10 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Tracks satisfaction scores after each resolved case and applies escalation handling to low-scoring contacts so unhappy customers reach the right team quickly.
slots.r1.b3: Updates help articles based on patterns found through ticket triage, reducing incoming tickets on covered topics by 20 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Documents tickets in detail after onboarding calls so teammates can pick up each new customer's history without asking the same questions again.
slots.r1.i1: Handles customer complaints at Dunmore Technologies by phone and live chat, working each issue through to a clear resolution.
slots.r1.i2: Serves as a link between customers and engineering at Dunmore Technologies, gathering details on reported bugs and escalating them for a fix.
slots.summary.1: Associate-level customer support professional with about 2 years of experience handling routine requests through live chat and phone, with a colleague reviewing the work. Uses macros and templates for consistent replies and reads satisfaction surveys to spot where answers can improve.
slots.summary.2: Customer support associate with about 2 years of experience resolving routine customer requests, with work checked by a colleague. Relies on live chat, macros and templates, and satisfaction surveys to keep answers quick, consistent and grounded in customer feedback.
